title: Missoula, MT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Missoula, MT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Missoula is a city in MT with a population of 75,000. Garden City with the University of Montana, five valleys, and world-class fly fishing. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
